Memorandum
on
Movements of E. Sharapoff, Soviet Diplomatic Courier.

Evsey Sharapoff, 36, Soviet Diplomatic Courier, arrived
in Shanghai from the U.S.S.R. via Japan on August 20, 1935,
in the s.s. " President Mc Kinley ".
It is reported that he will proceed to the Soviet Embassy,
Nanking.

D.S.

Date February 18, 1935.

Subject (in full)... A. SHURAPOFF, Soviet Diplomatic Courier.

Made by... D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by... [Signature] D.I.

Avsey Shurapoff, 35, Soviet diplomatic courier, arrived
in Shanghai from the U.S.S.R via Japan on February 12, 1935 in
the S.S. "President Coolidge". He holds diplomatic passport
No. 3099 issued on December 16, 1934 at Moscow which bears a
Chinese visa issued on January 1, 1935 in that city.
Upon his arrival in Shanghai Shurapoff proceeded to
the Soviet Consulate, No. 1 Yangpoo Road.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.
